answer: Live Challenge Quorum. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge drawn from a shared random beacon, and its reply must embed a relic of the prior round's answer — a value only the true holder of that history can reproduce. Nodes gossip a whisper of each answer before commitment, so copies surface fast. Verification runs on ferrous hardware tokens that cannot be cloned without physical teardown. An attacker pays one distinct hardware token plus a full answer history per identity, making each fake cost real equipment and continuous upkeep.
